concerns.text: The document metadata fields (document_type, program, process, and status) are represented as Java String fields rather than proper Java Enum types, missing out on JVM/compile-time type safety.
Academic years in the database check constraint allow both hyphen ('-') and en-dash ('–') variations (e.g., '2026-2027' and '2026–2027'), which can introduce data normalization inconsistency.

The FinancialDocumentController contains hardcoded default values ('2026-09-01' and '123-P') as fallbacks if the database records have null values, which may lead to incorrect metadata representation.
